subject: history_social
passage: In 1271, the young Venetian Marco Polo set out for Asia with his father and his uncle, both merchants. By the time he returned to Venice in 1295, he ______ more than two decades traveling and working in lands ruled by the Mongol emperor Kublai Khan. A few years later, an account of his journeys, written down with the help of a writer named Rustichello, began to circulate across Europe.
stem: Which choice completes the text so that it conforms to the conventions of Standard English?

explanation.why: The phrase "By the time he returned to Venice in 1295" sets a moment in the past, and the years of travel were finished before that moment. An action completed before another past action takes the past perfect, so "had spent" is correct.
explanation.A: Incorrect. "Has spent" is present perfect, which connects to the present, but the time frame here ends in 1295.
explanation.B: Correct. "Had spent" is past perfect, showing the travels were completed before his return in 1295.
explanation.C: Incorrect. "Spends" is present tense, but the events took place in the 1200s.
explanation.D: Incorrect. "Will have spent" is future perfect, but the passage describes events that are already in the past.
